Thank you for writing to Northwind County Public Works about the Harbor Road Upgrade. You raised 4 questions, and we answer each one below.

**1. Noise and hours.** Night works on Harbor Road run from 8 pm to 5 am, Monday to Thursday, for no more than 12 nights in total. Noise is monitored on site and the loudest activities finish before 11 pm. [Source: APR-104]

Yours sincerely,
Northwind County Public Works
